svg.title: InspectRT cross-platform latency and nearest-neighbour index comparison
svg.desc: Panel A shows p50 to p95 pipeline stage latency for six environments. Panel B shows exact top-1 nearest-neighbour index differences for five completed candidates, including MPS.
